Unlike traditional ransomware groups, dispossessor is classified as a data broker, suggesting its activities may focus on harvesting and selling sensitive information rather than direct extortion. First seen in February 2020 and last observed in August 2024, the actor remains active but lacks clear targeting preferences for sectors or geographies.
goals: Dispossessor appears to target victims primarily for their ability to generate revenue through data monetization rather than direct ransomware extortion.
